'''2012 Worlds Day 2 Marc Nickels LS Local Uprising''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Marc Nickels]] at [[2012 World Championship]] (Day 2).

* '''Player:''' [[Marc Nickels]]

* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]

* '''Username:''' Darkbow
